meta.title: Vietnamese Street Food Cooking Class Hoi An
meta.description:
Join me with Chef Tram Long on an unforgettable culinary journey through the vibrant street food of Vietnam in this immersive cooking class! Get ready to tantalize your taste buds with the rich flavors and aromas of traditional Vietnamese street food.

In this hands-on experience, Chef Tram will takes us on a trip to a bustling traditional market, where you'll discover the freshest ingredients and learn the art of selecting the perfect produce for our dishes. From fragrant herbs to exotic spices, immerse yourself in the sights, sounds, and scents of authentic Vietnamese cuisine.

Back in the kitchen, Chef Tram will guide us through the secrets of crafting three iconic dishes:

Banh Xeo: Experience the crispy goodness of these sizzling Vietnamese pancakes filled with savory goodness. Learn how to achieve the perfect golden-brown crisp and fill them with a delectable combination of shrimp, bean sprouts, and pork.

Spring Rolls: Master the art of rolling your own fresh spring rolls, bursting with vibrant vegetables, aromatic herbs, and succulent shrimp & pork. Discover the techniques behind achieving that signature delicate wrapper and dipping sauce that elevates every bite.

Pork Noodle Salad (Bun Thit Nuong): Dive into the refreshing flavors of this classic Vietnamese dish featuring tender grilled pork, noodles, crisp greens, and a zesty dressing. Learn how to balance the sweet, sour, salty, and spicy elements that make this salad a culinary delight.

Whether you're a novice cook or a seasoned foodie, this class offers something for everyone. Chef Tram's expertise and passion for Vietnamese cuisine will inspire you to recreate these authentic flavors in your own kitchen.

Join us for an unforgettable culinary adventure and discover the magic of Vietnamese street food! Don't forget to subscribe for more delicious recipes and culinary tips.
